name: Unrefreshing sleep
description: Inadequate or disturbed sleep that fails to provide restorative rest.

name: Daytime drowsiness
description: Excessive daytime sleepiness, or, a desire to sleep or take a nap during the day.

name: Difficulty Staying Asleep
description: Difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep, also known as insomnia.

name: Waking up early
description: Waking up earlier than desired, feeling unrefreshed or tired.

name: Heavy feeling
description: Feeling of heaviness in body, limbs, or head.

name: Mental Fatigue
description: Feeling of exhaustion, difficulty concentrating.

name: Fatigue
description: Feeling of tiredness, lack of energy.

name: Muscle weakness
description: Loss of strength in muscles, reduced physical ability.

name: Shortness of breath
description: Feeling of breathlessness, difficulty breathing.

name: Cough
description: Expelling air from lungs due to irritation, inflammation, or infection.

name: Chest pain
description: Pain or discomfort in the chest area.

name: Irregular heartbeat (arrhythmia)
description: An abnormal heart rhythm, irregular heartbeat or palpitations.

name: Elevated heartbeat
description: Increased heart rate, above normal resting level.

name: Rash
description: Skin irritation, redness or inflammation.

name: Pins and needles
description: Tingling or prickling sensation in the skin.

name: Tinnitus (ringing in ears)
description: Ringing, buzzing or other noises in the ears.

name: Brain fog
description: Difficulty concentrating, mental fatigue, confusion.

name: Difficulty remembering
description: Difficulty recalling information, forgetfulness.

name: Trouble paying attention
description: Difficulty focusing, easily distracted.

name: Trouble forming words
description: Difficulty articulating words or phrases, slurring.

name: Difficulty understanding
description: Difficulty comprehending or processing information.

name: Difficulty focusing
description: Difficulty concentrating attention on a task.

name: Slowness of thought
description: Mental sluggishness, slow thinking.

name: Sensitivity to noise
description: Heightened awareness of sounds, discomfort or pain from noise.

name: Sensitivity to Light
description: Increased sensitivity to light, discomfort or pain from bright lights.

name: Sensitivity to Smells
description: Heightened awareness or discomfort to certain smells.

name: Unpleasant smell
description: Offensive or unpleasant odor perceived by the nose.

name: Unable to focus vision
description: Difficulty focusing or maintaining visual attention.

name: Loss of depth perception
description: Difficulty judging the distance and spatial relationship of objects.

name: Twitching
description: Involuntary muscle movement or spasm.

name: Absent mindedness
description: Lack of attention or forgetfulness due to preoccupation.

name: Anxiety
description: Feeling of unease, fear, worry, or apprehension.

name: Depression
description: Persistent feeling of sadness, hopelessness, or low mood.

name: Dizziness
description: Feeling of lightheadedness or unsteadiness, vertigo.

name: Sore throat
description: Pain, irritation or discomfort in the throat.

name: Lymph nodes
description: Swollen or tender lymph nodes, part of immune system.

name: Fever
description: Elevated body temperature, often due to infection or inflammation.

name: High temperature
description: Elevated body temperature above normal range.

name: Flu-like symptoms
description: Symptoms resembling those of the flu, including fever, fatigue, muscle aches, and respiratory symptoms.

name: Cold limbs
description: Decreased temperature or poor blood flow to the limbs, making them feel cold.

name: Chills
description: Shivering or feeling cold despite adequate clothing or warm environment.

name: Feeling hot
description: Sensation of feeling warm or hot.

name: Night sweats
description: Excessive sweating during sleep, often soaking through clothing and bedding.

name: Sweating hands
description: Excessive sweating of the palms.

name: Weight change
description: Increase or decrease in body weight beyond normal variations.

name: Loss of appetite
description: Decreased desire to eat or loss of interest in food.

name: Low temperature
description: Body temperature below normal range.

name: Muscle pain
description: Aching or soreness in muscles due to overuse or injury.

name: Headache
description: Pain or discomfort in the head, scalp or neck.

name: Eye pain
description: Pain or discomfort in or around the eyes.

name: Soreness
description: Pain or discomfort in muscles, joints or tissues.

name: Joint pain
description: Pain or discomfort in joints, often due to inflammation or injury.

name: Bloating
description: Feeling of fullness, swelling or discomfort in the abdomen.

name: Bladder issues
description: Problems with urination, such as pain, urgency, or incontinence.

name: Sensitivity to alcohol
description: Adverse physical reaction to alcohol consumption, including flushing, nausea, or headache.

name: Stomach pain
description: Pain or discomfort in the abdomen or stomach area.

name: Diarrhea
description: Frequent passage of loose or watery stools.

name: Nausea
description: Feeling of sickness or discomfort in the stomach, often accompanied by an urge to vomit.

name: Nausea when standing up from being seated or upright
description: Feeling of nausea that occurs upon standing or sitting up.

name: Chest pain when standing up from being seated or upright
description: Chest pain that occurs upon standing or sitting up.

name: Feeling unsteady when standing up from being seated or upright
description: Feeling of unsteadiness or imbalance upon standing or sitting up.

name: Shortness of breath when standing up from being seated or upright
description: Feeling of difficulty breathing that occurs upon standing or sitting up.

name: Dizziness when standing up from being seated or upright
description: Feeling of lightheadedness, faintness, or unsteadiness upon standing or sitting up.

name: Irregular heartbeat (arrhythmia) when standing up from being seated or upright
description: An abnormal heart rhythm, irregular heartbeat or palpitations upon standing or sitting up.

name: Elevated heartbeat when standing up from being seated or upright
description: A sudden increase in heart rate upon standing or sitting up.
